title: Phase 55J promotes nine bounded policy, research, workforce, and infrastructure records
summary: FTFN promoted all nine Phase 55I signals after a record-by-record publication review. The review added OMB memorandum M-26-04 to preserve the current federal AI policy stack and retained explicit boundaries between policy and implementation, funding and delivery, program reach and outcomes, metropolitan or system evidence and site readiness, and planning forecasts and service commitments.
evidence_note: Promotion confirms that each record is independently useful and adequately bounded; it does not convert policy into implementation, beta infrastructure into adoption, planned spending into production, guidance into product authorization, participation into impact, awards into deployed services, metropolitan estimates into workforce sufficiency, citywide plans into site capacity, or provincial forecasts into a connection commitment.
